svg.title: Public NDCG went from 0.3739 to 0.3953 in nine days; 0.018 of the 0.021 came on the first day

cc:Work.dc:title: Public NDCG went from 0.3739 to 0.3953 in nine days; 0.018 of the 0.021 came on the first day
cc:Work.dc:description: Two stacked scatter plots of public NDCG against submission order. Top: all 40 files; the team best climbs from 0.3739 to 0.3921 over the six files of 11 November and then flattens. Bottom: detail of 12 to 19 November between 0.392 and 0.3987; the team best steps up eight more times, to 0.39282 and then 0.39345 with pools of rankers trained on clicks, 0.39449 with distilled students, 0.39501 with the popularity-light blend W8P20, 0.39521 with FD16P20@m0.4_0.2 (pick 1) on 17 November and 0.39526 with FDX16P20:ps (pick 2) on 19 November. On the board of 19 November, place 2 is at 0.398058, the leader at 0.398256, and the team is at rank 9 of 541.
